footnotes: Fourth quarters (Q4 2024, Q4 2025) have no 10-Q: they are the full year in the 10-K less the nine months in the third-quarter 10-Q.
Cash flow figures are reported year-to-date; each quarter is the year-to-date total less the previous quarter's. Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property and equipment.

Diluted EPS is not additive across quarters. Where the filing gives no three-month EPS (fourth quarters), it is calculated as net income to common ÷ estimated diluted shares (the full-year weighted average × 4 less the nine-month average × 3), and may differ from the reported figure by a cent or two.
Other operating expenses = gross profit − operating income − the expense lines shown.
Interest & other, net = pre-tax income − operating income. Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding. QoQ compares with Q3 2025; YoY with Q4 2024.

events.t: On January 23, 2026, the Board of Directors of Unusual Machines, Inc. (the “Company”) approved an amendment to the Company’s Amended and Restated Bylaws to add the executive officer positions of President and Chief Revenue Officer (the “Amendment”).

On January 15, 2026, Unusual Machines, Inc. (the “Company”) issued a press release, announcing a $2.1 million purchase order supporting domestically assembled drone systems for defense and government applications.

On November 12, 2025, Unusual Machines, Inc., a Nevada corporation (“Unusual Machines”) invested $25 million into XTI Aerospace, Inc., a Nevada corporation (“XTI”), a corporation engaged in the drone business in the United States.

On November 6, 2025, Unusual Machines, Inc. (the “Company”) is issuing a press release containing a Letter to Shareholders regarding the quarterly report for the quarter ended September 30, 2025 on Form 10-Q also being filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on that date.
On October 30, 2025, the Company entered into a Lease Agreement (the “Lease”) pursuant to which the Company will lease approximately 25,000 rentable square foot space for drone headset manufacturing.

(e) On September 30, 2025, the Board of Directors (the “Board”) of Unusual Machines, Inc. (the “Company”) approved a Resolution establishing the compensation for the non-management directors of the Company at $160,000 per year, payable in equal quarterly installments.
